description: Shake It Off is... I love her but I am TIRED bestie 😒💅 It's been played into the ground at every party since 2014 and I physically cringe when it comes on. The haters gonna hate thing is iconic, sure, but the cringe of the 'sick beat' is real. It's a skip for me now, sorry not sorry, mother has way better songs. Classic but overplayed to death 🔥
